DISCORD_TOKEN.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Discord bot token. Create an application at https://discord.com/developers/applications, add a Bot, then copy its token.

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.name: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID
DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Discord application client ID (Developer Portal -> General Information -> Application ID). Used to build the bot invite link.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: YouTube Data API v3 key from https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials. Required for YouTube search and playback.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Spotify API client ID. Optional — enables resolving Spotify tracks, albums and playlists.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Spotify API client secret. Optional — required only if SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID is set.

DATA_DIR.name: DATA_DIR
DATA_DIR.description: Directory holding the SQLite database and audio cache. Must match the mount path of the attached Railway Volume.

CACHE_LIMIT.name: CACHE_LIMIT
CACHE_LIMIT.description: Maximum disk space used by the audio cache, e.g. 2GB. Keep below your Railway Volume size.

ENABLE_SPONSORBLOCK.name: ENABLE_SPONSORBLOCK
ENABLE_SPONSORBLOCK.description: Set to true to skip non-music segments using SponsorBlock data.

BOT_STATUS.name: BOT_STATUS
BOT_STATUS.description: Presence shown in Discord: online, dnd, idle or invisible.

BOT_ACTIVITY_TYPE.name: BOT_ACTIVITY_TYPE
BOT_ACTIVITY_TYPE.description: Activity type: PLAYING, STREAMING, LISTENING, WATCHING or COMPETING.

BOT_ACTIVITY.name: BOT_ACTIVITY
BOT_ACTIVITY.description: Activity text shown next to the bot's presence in Discord.
